name: Deleting a trip can be undone and the same trip comes back

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
There are 3 trip rows and the status panel shows 64 days used
Note the dates of the first trip row (data-testid=trip-row), then click its delete button (data-testid=trip-delete)
There are 2 trip rows, the deleted dates are gone, and days used is lower than 64
Click 'Undo' in the 'Trip deleted' notification at the bottom of the page
There are 3 trip rows again, one of them has exactly the dates noted before deleting, and the status panel shows 64 days used
